snapshot_note: Session #74 (macOS release lane, task #21): W1/W2/W4 shipped AND the first real Mac battery run found two ABI defects no Linux lane can see, both fixed. (1) MIR fork e2c0ae95 + 731c2234 (two commits — the first cut also dropped SysV x86-64's %al, which a prototype-less call needs since the callee may be variadic; that broke an undeclared printf and ONLY the EXE/OBJ legs caught it while JIT passed all 1018. Correct shape = vararg proto whose FIXED args are the actual args: fixed list places them, flag keeps %al. The gate is now two-sided and rejects both errors): c2mir compiled an UNPROTOTYPED call as variadic; Apple arm64 passes every vararg on the stack, so the callee read registers and got residue (its own address as arg 0). The proto now comes from the call site's actual default-promoted arg types. This was the entire memory-writing C surface on darwin (SDK _FORTIFY_SOURCE __builtin___*_chk served by undeclared madc helpers) and would break every C89 implicit call there. Gate: scripts/unprototyped_call_abi_gate.sh (IR-shape, since behaviour cannot distinguish the shapes on x86-64; a variadic callee in the same TU is its negative control). (2) The darwin flavor's runtime list shipped EMPTY because link_libs() read a Mach-O with readelf, so a Mac had no libc++ to dlopen and every mangled-direct C++ static went undeclared (_ZNSt3__15ctypeIcE2idE); the probe is now format-aware (-dumpmachine + llvm-otool -L). Mac battery 2/4 -> 3/3 passed. Two darwin-only C++ defects remain, both reduced (see the plan doc).

VLA NOT DEALLOCATED ON BACKWARD GOTO: a `goto` jumping back to before a VLA's declaration must deallocate the VLA (gcc/C semantics; gcc-torture 20040811-1.c). madc lowers VLAs as malloc + __attribute__((cleanup)), which frees only on SCOPE EXIT, not on the backward goto re-entering the scope — so a backward-goto loop over a VLA LEAKS one allocation per iteration. 20040811-1.c leaks ~2GB over 1e6 iterations; it passes only when memory is available (it OOM-SIGSEGV'd when the MIR fork's 128MB code-holder reservation reduced headroom — see mir_fork; arch-gated off x86-64, so it passes again). Proper fix: free the VLA at the backward goto. Separate future slice.

MadArray/MadValue namespacing is an open API/ABI follow-up: moving the real C++ types to madc::array and madc::value would give PHP array helpers a normal namespace type surface, but compatibility aliases alone will not preserve old C++ mangled names.

Embedded <iostream> output remains partially staged: cout/cerr/clog still use header-defined stdio-backed ostream bodies. Follow-up is to replace that output surface with real libstdc++ declarations/operators, matching the std::cin direction; do not add stdio.h/FILE* stream bridges.
